name: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited
summary: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited manufactures, markets, and distributes hair care, cosmetics, toiletries, and other personal care products in India and internationally. The company offers hair oil and serum, shampoo, body lotion, and soap under the Bajaj Almond Drops brand name; and castor, coconut, virgin coconut, olive, kalonji, and jojoba oil under the Bajaj 100% Pure brand. It also provides face scrub, face wash, hand sanitizer, soap, cream, and face serum under the Bajaj Nomarks brand name; and hair masque, hair oil, argan oil, hair serum, and almond oil under the Natyv Soul brand name.
